title: Walkthrough of Improving Resume Achievements Ep.1
description:
Leave your title in the comments and we’ll cover yours next! Writing a great resume achievement is difficult but when does right is the way that your resume will start landing you interviews. Some general rules: you want to show impact, not a task…you want to show specifics, not vague statements…include metrics and time based statements for the best results. #resumetips #resumetip #resumebullets #resumebuilder #resumewriting
